thread:
Devon: FYI — handing off the ARM64 + GKE starter templates to the partner team. Repo: https://github.com/redwood-refkits/arm-gke-starter. Need quick review on module inputs, a tiny smoke CI for ARM nodes, and a 1-click sandbox command. Who can pick this up?

Omar: I can take module compatibility + CI. Quick ask: make sure node pool supports taints/tolerations and autoscaling. Also expose a nodeSelector/arch var for future GPU nodes.

Tess: I can do API surface review. Suggest we expose: `instance_type`, `node_count_min`, `node_count_max`, and `enable_node_autoscaling` as variables. Also add an example k8s deployment that pulls a small demo image (hello-llm).

Devon: nice. For the 1-click sandbox, let's add a tiny script `scripts/deploy-sandbox.sh` that wraps `terraform init && terraform apply -auto-approve -var-file=ci/arm.tfvars`. Partner wants teardown too.

Carla: Partner asked for cost-estimate pointers and a cleanup script. They want the sample to be runnable in a 2-hour workshop. Also can we include a short doc with cloud costs for ARM vs x86?

partner-ci-bot: CI run #4872: arm64-smoke (k8s-1.25) — ✅ all jobs succeeded (terraform fmt, terraform validate, plan, k8s-smoke). Logs: https://ci.redwood.dev/builds/4872 :tada:

Tess: awesome. I'll open PR with the variable suggestions and add the sample k8s manifest. Example variable block to include in README:

```
variable "instance_type" {
  description = "Node instance type (arm64)"
  type        = string
  default     = "c6g.large"
}
```

Devon: @tess can you also add a small `canary_publish` job in the marketplace pipeline that publishes the sample to a staging catalog and runs 1 smoke deployment? I'll create release branch `partner/arm-gke/rc1` after PR merges.

Omar: I'll add a `tests/arm-smoke.tf` with a minimal plan and assert on created node pool name. Quick local test command:

```
terraform plan -var "instance_type=c6g.large" -var "node_count_min=1" -var "node_count_max=3"
```

Carla: I'll coordinate a partner demo slot for Thu next week and prep the workshop checklist. Also will pull cost numbers with our finance partner.

Devon: Great progress — timeline: review + PR this week, CI canary next Tue, publish to staging Wed, partner demo Thu. Thanks everyone.

Omar: ack — I'll push the tests by EOD and wire up the CI matrix for arm/x86.

Tess: ack, opening PR shortly.

Carla: thanks team — looping partner PM and solutions lead. @devon @tess @omar
